description: Bounded provider-neutral fixtures used to verify that canonical Metkagram language objects can become productive spoken-practice tasks without copying the source corpus.

practice_projection.communicative_job: Use a reviewed evidence frame to support a hypothesis without presenting it as proof.
practice_projection.production_prompt: A pilot improved one metric, but the sample is still small. Explain what the result suggests without treating it as proof.
practice_projection.self_check: Did you separate evidence from proof and leave room for another explanation?
practice_projection.transfer_prompt: Now use the same reasoning move for a delayed project where one signal points to a cause but alternatives still remain.

practice_projection.communicative_job: Choose the right reviewed reasoning frame first, then produce a fresh utterance with that function.
practice_projection.production_prompt: A first benchmark looks promising but is not decisive. Choose the better Metkagram frame, then say one new sentence about the evidence in your own words.
practice_projection.self_check: Did your wording match the selected function rather than merely repeat the benchmark scenario?
practice_projection.transfer_prompt: Repeat the task with a user-behaviour signal that points to a UX problem but does not prove it.

practice_projection.communicative_job: Follow a reviewed reasoning route to correct an interpretation without flattening the nuance.
practice_projection.production_prompt: A team says a project is failing because people lack motivation. Reframe the situation so the stronger underlying constraint becomes visible, while preserving any part of the original concern that may still be true.
practice_projection.self_check: Did you choose the strength of correction deliberately instead of treating every disagreement as full negation?
practice_projection.transfer_prompt: Use the same route on a different topic: a product is called unsuccessful because adoption is low, but discoverability may be the more useful frame.
